traits.name: Hunt Prey
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate); The bounty hunter designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The bounty hunter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek the prey and to Survival checks to Track the prey. This effect lasts until the bounty hunter uses Hunt Prey again.

traits.name: Running Reload
traits.text: ⬻ The bounty hunter Stride, Steps, or Sneaks, and then Interacts to reload.

traits.name: Precision Edge
traits.text: The first time the bounty hunter hits their hunted prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 (1d8) precision damage.

traits.text: crossbow (10 bolts), falchion, simple manacles, studded leather;
